{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ergesh federation''' was the ruling authority of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]]. It was comprised of the oldest member of each [[Ergesh]] clan. The federation met on a monthly basis at the [[Communal Pool]]. The federation kept in regular contact with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
